title: Preserve named rasgueado finger patterns
scope: Add a semantic pattern representation for GPIF rasgueado while defining legacy boolean compatibility.
acceptance: Inventory every named pattern in the pinned importer and give each a separate behavior assertion.
Use at least two distinct non-default patterns in a public import/edit/export case.
An unspecified legacy boolean has a documented target decision; unknown patterns are diagnosed without substituting a random gesture.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
All eighteen non-default patterns plus None and original GP7 source/export compare raw pinned consumer values and locations.

resolution: All eighteen GPIF finger patterns have a typed public representation and exact GP8 encoding. Legacy boolean-only marks normalize explicitly to pinned Ii default; edit authority, clearing, conflicts, unknown source and invalid public values are tested. Original GP7 source and all named patterns pass raw AlphaTab checks. Independent final-commit review and combined full gates/probe are assigned to root; GitHub remains open.
verification: Public regression failed before implementation and now passes.
Focused public/GPIF/matrix and pinned AlphaTab tests pass; all 19 enum constants have separate behavior evidence.
Full conformance/check.sh, capability probe and prek are assigned to root integration; fresh review pending.
